rank_math_title: 4 Day Bwindi Gorilla Trekking Safari from Entebbe
rank_math_desc: 4 day Bwindi gorilla trekking safari from Entebbe: 2 nights at Gorilla Safari Lodge, a gorilla trek and Batwa visit. From USD 2,856 per adult.
post_content: This 4 day Bwindi gorilla trekking safari takes you from Entebbe to Bwindi Impenetrable National Park for a mountain gorilla trek and a Batwa cultural visit, with 2 nights at Gorilla Safari Lodge.
overview:
This 4 day Bwindi gorilla trekking safari is a private road trip from Entebbe to Bwindi Impenetrable National Park in southwest Uganda. You spend 1 night at Kampala Serena Hotel and 2 nights at Gorilla Safari Lodge, with one gorilla trek and a Batwa cultural visit on day 3. Prices start from USD 2,856 per adult, and it suits travellers with limited time who want a gorilla encounter.

The trip uses a pop-up roof extended Land Cruiser with an English-speaking driver guide, full board at the lodge and airport transfers, so it works for couples, small groups and solo travellers who are fit enough for a steep forest hike.

Why choose a 4 day Bwindi gorilla trekking safari?

Bwindi Impenetrable National Park is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and home to nearly half of the world's remaining mountain gorillas. A 4 day trip gives you the trek itself, a rest day margin around it and the Batwa community visit without needing a full week off work.

The park also holds over 120 mammal species and about 350 bird species, so the forest walk to the gorillas is a nature experience in its own right. Read our Bwindi gorilla trekking guide to see how the sectors and gorilla families work, or add chimpanzees and Murchison Falls with the 9 day gorilla and chimpanzee trekking safari.

  • Short breaks: a gorilla trek in 4 days from Entebbe.
  • Culture: an afternoon with the Batwa, the original forest people of Bwindi.
  • Comfort: 2 nights at Gorilla Safari Lodge on full board.

What to expect on the 4 day Bwindi gorilla trekking safari

Day 1 starts with a meet-and-greet at Entebbe International Airport and a transfer to Kampala Serena Hotel, with an optional short orientation drive around Entebbe on Lake Victoria if time allows.

On day 2 you leave at about 6:00 AM for the long drive of about 10 to 12 hours to Bwindi, stopping at the Uganda Equator crossing and for lunch in Mbarara. You reach Gorilla Safari Lodge in the evening.

Day 3 is trekking day. After the 8:00 AM ranger briefing at park headquarters you hike for 2 to 8 hours, depending on where your gorilla family is, and spend one hour with the gorillas. In the afternoon you visit the Batwa community. On day 4 you leave at about 5:00 AM and drive back via Mbarara to Entebbe or Kampala for your flight or hotel.

How fit do you need to be for gorilla trekking in Bwindi?

Gorilla trekking in Bwindi needs reasonable fitness. The trails can be steep, muddy and slow, and the hike can take 2 to 8 hours. Rangers assign gorilla families by fitness level at the briefing, and porters can usually be hired at the start. See our guide on how hard gorilla trekking is and our gorilla trekking packing list.

What is included in the 4 day Bwindi gorilla trekking safari?

The price includes a pop-up roof extended Land Cruiser, an English-speaking driver guide, fuel and all ground transport, Bwindi Impenetrable National Park fees and park entrance fees for clients, vehicle and guide, full-board accommodation, en-route lunches, drinking water in the vehicle, a ranger during game drives, all taxes and airport transfers. Accommodation can be chosen at luxury, mid-range or budget level.

Not included are visas, passports, domestic and international flights, beers and wines, and personal items. The page does not list the gorilla trekking permit separately, so we confirm the permit and its cost in your written quote.

From USD 2,856 per adult. The final price depends on your travel dates, group size and the lodges available, and we confirm every lodge in your written quote.

faq.q: When is the best time for the 4 day Bwindi gorilla trekking safari?
faq.a: The 4 day Bwindi gorilla trekking safari runs all year, because the gorillas live in the forest in every season. The drier months, usually June to September and December to February, have firmer trails and are the most popular, so book permits early. In the wetter months the forest is greener and quieter, but the hike can be muddier.

faq.q: What is included in the 4 day Bwindi gorilla trekking safari?
faq.a: The 4 day Bwindi gorilla trekking safari includes a pop-up roof Land Cruiser with an English-speaking driver guide, fuel, Bwindi park fees, full-board accommodation, en-route lunches, drinking water, taxes and airport transfers. Visas, flights, drinks and personal items are extra. We confirm the gorilla permit and its cost in your written quote.

faq.q: Where do you stay on the 4 day Bwindi gorilla trekking safari?
faq.a: On the 4 day Bwindi gorilla trekking safari you stay 1 night at Kampala Serena Hotel after you land and 2 nights at Gorilla Safari Lodge, close to the forest in Bwindi Impenetrable National Park. The lodge is on full board. Luxury, mid-range and budget options can be arranged, and we confirm them in your quote.

faq.q: Is the 4 day Bwindi gorilla trekking safari suitable for families?
faq.a: Families can join the 4 day Bwindi gorilla trekking safari, but Uganda Wildlife Authority only allows gorilla trekking from age 15. Younger children can stay at the lodge or join the Batwa visit. Adults need reasonable fitness, as the trek can take 2 to 8 hours on steep, muddy trails, and the drive to Bwindi takes 10 to 12 hours.
